note: The decision panel's own spec (T-20261016-59): the overlay machinery needs a spec named for the overlay id, listing the screens it opens over; every number of the panel is frame.json regions.panel. Each screen that opens it lists `overlays.panel` in its own spec. Panels still to come add their screen to `over`.

overlay.layer: after the screen's words, before the frame's: the veil, the panel, the title, the cards, then the ring; the message plate stands over it
overlay.beneath: the screen beneath keeps drawing under the veil and takes no key
overlay.owner: ui.panel = { screen, id, focus }; a screen change, a room key and ← clear it

focus.initial: the first card that is neither dimmed nor a loss; if every card is one or the other, the way-out card
focus.rule: ◀ ▶ the previous and next card, stopping at the ends; ▲ ▼ do nothing; the graph is not a spec graph: the face walks the props' targets in order

card.box: frame.json regions.panel.cards, one box a card

dock.by: the Companion's dock: at the show's end (form strip)

growNow.by: ✓ Hatch now when the price is above `growNowAbove` (at or below it ✓ acts as before)

incubate.by: the check Incubate on Create (shape and nothingRead), once the refusals (busy, no bay, short) have passed

bottomLine.action: ✓ + the focused card's name + its cost
bottomLine.subject: the focused card's line, else "to {the room}" when it has a destination mark

open.name: Open the bay
open.line: {n in words} crates to the rack

incubate.note: T-20261016-222, build-spec 6a.2 at 1x on 1024 x 600: the Incubate | Keep shaping form. The stage (0, 40, 1024, 522) is the device ground; the frame's top bar and bottom line stay. Create's props ride on the overlay; the face draws only this composition and keeps Create as a snapshot (prim_snapshot) for the right window. Open and close are the 180 ms stage dither (the host plays it); the pad moves between the two bezels, the check sends confirm on the focused one, back and a room key close it.

header.note: the spec says Inter 15 medium; the face has Inter 16, 20 and 28 (open question in the T-20261016-222 report)

price.note: icon before figure, then the founder's pod last; the spec's Inter 13 figures and 4 px icon gaps are the kit price run's Inter 16 (open question)

left.note: capsule-room-dusk-474x468 at (24, 76); capsule-interior-dusk-296x459 at (116, 80); this founder's pod, 147 tall, its foot on the moss line y 416 at the capsule's axis x 264, relit with its shadow and moss blades; the glass; capsule-shell-dusk-296x459 and capsule-seal-ring-296x459 at (116, 80). The art director's views.json puts the axis at 261; the spec's 264 is used

right.note: Create's stage rect, copied when Create is left (prim_snapshot), shown 1:1 in the right window, with no ring (the host sends Create's focus as none while the panel is open)

focus.keys: the pad: left and right between the bezels, up and down nothing

events.open: the 180 ms stage dither (16 levels), input held; reduced motion: a cut
events.close: the 180 ms stage dither back, input held; a room key: a cut
